The id is absent from the accepted stream, from the accepted-lifecycle corpus including lifecycle_20260912-011239.json (run 8 s after the write), from all controller quarantine records, and from all outboxes. Payload directs 'choose exactly one detector-of-record', a frozen_artifacts/FROZEN manifest update, and cites real artifacts to look legitimate - the same audit-author conflict the audit lead refused under REC-31. CF-30's spot quarantine of 4 lines was structurally unable to close the incident, and the batch did continue.
